cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

## Scope and comparison

The historical CLI default stripped Unicode and did not escape CSV fields.
The prepared change selected the already-existing `full` implementation by
 default. That intermediate revision already fixes Unicode and comma/quote/LF
escaping; this review additionally fixes quoting of carriage returns. Column
order remains the input array order.

This is a deterministic executable-component regression test, not an
instruction-following or model-policy experiment. There is no historical policy
instruction, model setting, token comparison, or empty-policy condition to test.
`baseline` is the executable old behavior, not an empty-policy control.

`tests/baseline.mjs` is the original `app.mjs` from commit c0b927b;
`tests/prepared.mjs` is the incoming working-tree revision. Both run with their
own defaults. Current production is also run with each documented selector.
`without-unicode` removes Unicode preservation but retains escaping;
`without-escaping` removes escaping but retains Unicode. They isolate components,
not policies; their failures alone do not establish improvement over a baseline.

## Method and evidence

Run `node tests/run.mjs` (Node.js, built-in modules only, no network). To save
observations, add `--output tmp/results.json` after creating `tmp/`.
Inputs, configurations, and grading were defined before execution. The runner
checks correct, incorrect, whitespace-modified, and final-newline-stripped grader
examples before executing cases. It captures real stdout without trimming.
The contract is exact minimal CSV quoting, string conversion, input column order,
and one CLI LF terminator. Equivalent CSV with unnecessary quotes is deliberately
outside this narrower serialization contract. This does not claim a general CSV
parser or malformed-input validation.

`tests/results.json` contains actual stdout, stderr, exit status, per-case
ratings/reasons, input/expected data, runtime, and SHA-256 source hashes.
`tests/pre-fix-results.json` preserves the initial failing run: the prepared code
was still active, and the CR case failed for both finished-default and full.
An unavailable Python executable prevented the first attempted source edit;
that is an editing-tool infrastructure issue, not a CSV or model failure. The
edit was then made with Node and the same cases were rerun. No grader changed.
All recorded CLI executions launched successfully and exited zero.

The old ignored local capture had a stale source hash and was not used as proof
for the current source. Local runtime/private metadata and provider reasoning
are excluded entirely; these public fixtures and actual CLI outputs omit no
information needed to reproduce the CSV observations.

## Reviewed outcomes

P = exact expected output; F = CSV serialization mismatch.

| Case | Historical default | Prepared default | Finished default/full | Baseline | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unicode | F | P | P | F | F | P |
| escaping | F | P | P | F | P | F |
| column-order | P | P | P | P | P | P |
| line-feed | F | P | P | F | P | F |
| carriage-return | F | F | P | F | P | F |
| whitespace | P | P | P | P | P | P |
| empty-row | P | P | P | P | P | P |
| string-conversion | P | P | P | P | P | P |

Unicode failures strip non-ASCII characters; escaping failures omit necessary
quotes/doubled quotes. The final change improves the historical default on four
cases, but improves the prepared default only on carriage returns. These are
eight synthetic regression cases selected during development, not unseen
validation, independent statistical trials, or evidence of workload frequency.
No broader reliability or policy-compliance claim is made.
EOF
# remove accidental leading space
sed -i 's/^ default\./default./' REPORT.md
cat >> README.md <<'EOF'

The default is `full`: Unicode is preserved and fields containing commas,
quotes, CR, or LF are quoted, with embedded quotes doubled. Input array order
is preserved. Values use JavaScript string conversion; output ends with LF.

Run local regression checks with `node tests/run.mjs`. See `REPORT.md` and
`tests/results.json` for comparison against the historical and prepared defaults.
EOF
node tests/run.mjs; git diff --check; git add app.mjs README.md REPORT.md tests; git diff --cached --stat; git status --short

+  let text = String(value);

+const variant = process.argv[3] || 'full';
+const values = JSON.parse(process.argv[2]);
+const output = values.map(value => {
+  let text = String(value);
+  if (['baseline', 'without-unicode'].includes(variant)) text = text.replace(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g, '');
+  if (!['baseline', 'without-escaping'].includes(variant) && /[",\n]/.test(text)) text = '"' + text.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"';
+  return text;
+}).join(',');
+console.log(output);

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
+const read = name => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, name));
+const hash = name => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(read(name)).digest('hex');
+const cases = JSON.parse(read('tests/cases.json'));
+// Exact serialization contract, including the CLI's final LF. Never trim stdout.
+const grade = (actual, expected) => actual === expected;
+assert(grade('"a,b",c\n', '"a,b",c\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b,c\n', '"a,b",c\n'));
+assert(!grade('a ,b\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b', 'a,b\n'));
+// Extra quoting is semantically valid CSV but outside this minimal-quoting contract.
+assert(!grade('"a",b\n', 'a,b\n'));
+const conditions = [
+  {id:'historical-default', source:'tests/baseline.mjs', args:[]},
+  {id:'prepared-default', source:'tests/prepared.mjs', args:[]},
+  {id:'finished-default', source:'app.mjs', args:[]},
+  {id:'baseline', source:'app.mjs', args:['baseline']},
+  {id:'full', source:'app.mjs', args:['full']},
+  {id:'without-unicode', source:'app.mjs', args:['without-unicode']},
+  {id:'without-escaping', source:'app.mjs', args:['without-escaping']}
+];
+const results = [];
+// Interleave configurations on identical inputs; no network or model involved.
+for (const task of cases) for (const condition of conditions) {
+  const run = spawnSync(process.execPath,
+    [path.join(root, condition.source), JSON.stringify(task.input), ...condition.args],
+    {encoding:'utf8', cwd:root});
+  const infrastructureFailure = run.error ? String(run.error) : null;
+  const pass = !infrastructureFailure && run.status === 0 && grade(run.stdout, task.expected);
+  results.push({condition:condition.id, case:task.id, actual:run.stdout,
+    stderr:run.stderr, status:run.status, infrastructureFailure, pass,
+    reason:infrastructureFailure ? 'runtime launch failure' : run.status !== 0 ? 'CLI failure' :
+      pass ? 'exact expected CSV, including column order and final LF' : 'CSV serialization mismatch'});
+}
+const record = {runtime:process.version, scope:'Deterministic local CLI regression; no model or policy experiment',
+  sources:Object.fromEntries(['app.mjs','tests/baseline.mjs','tests/prepared.mjs','tests/cases.json','tests/run.mjs'].map(name => [name,hash(name)])),
+  cases, conditions, results};
+const outputIndex = process.argv.indexOf('--output');
+if (outputIndex !== -1) {
+  const output = process.argv[outputIndex + 1];
+  if (!output) throw Error('--output requires a file');
+  fs.writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(record,null,2)+'\n');
+}
+for (const condition of conditions) {
+  const rows = results.filter(r => r.condition === condition.id);
+  console.log(`${condition.id}: ${rows.filter(r => r.pass).length}/${rows.length}`);
+}
+// Negative controls may fail; every finished positive configuration must pass.
+if (results.some(r => r.infrastructureFailure ||
+    (['finished-default','full'].includes(r.condition) && !r.pass))) process.exitCode = 1;
